<Resort> to <Mountain> - Driving Tour
Tour-Category: driving

Stop 5: <Mountain> cable car

Coordinates: 10.2000, 106.2000

Type/Specialty: Cable car

The ride is a thrilling experience, taking a -long cable car over the forest. The cabins glide above the treetops. The upper station opens onto a terrace.

Directions: Continue to the statue.

Stop 6: <Statue>

Coordinates: 10.2100, 106.2100

Type/Specialty: Statue

The statue was constructed in 1963 by sculptor <Person A>. It is the longest reclining Buddha in <Country>. Pilgrims climb the steps in the morning.

Directions: Continue to the hall.

Stop 7: <Statue> hall

Coordinates: 10.2200, 106.2200

Type/Specialty: Reclining Buddha

You can take a half-day tour here that includes a cable car ride. <Person B> began carving this 49-meter-long Reclining Buddha statue. It is also one of the largest in the world. It is home to a quiet garden.

That's 3 stops in all.
